summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K reporting routine continuous private placement activity: approximately $6.1 million of subscriptions for 242,434 common shares received September 1, 2026, sold at NAV under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S. The board declared a regular $0.1852 per-share distribution payable October 28, 2026 to holders of record September 29, 2026. As of August 31, 2026, NAV per share was $25.03, aggregate NAV approximately $2,097.7 million, debt-to-equity 1.17x, net leverage 1.14x. No special-situation transaction, no deal terms; watch monthly NAV pricing and leverage trends.
